verdict.rationale:
Unity ships extensive official SDK surfaces for programmatic/AI-native use: public scripting APIs (unity-docs-11), a first-party CLI for automation/CI (unity-docs-25, unity-probe-rt-4), an official Editor extensibility API (unity-docs-10), a UPM package ecosystem with resolvable registry (unity-probe-rt-5), an on-device inference SDK (Sentis, unity-docs-27), and an official MCP server bridging LLM agents to the Editor (unity-docs-23, unity-probe-4, unity-probe-rt-1). Docs confirm the CLI's `unity mcp`/`unity eval` modes are purpose-built for agent-driven workflows, moving beyond the deprecated in-editor MCP.
missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of these SDKs' reliability in agentic pipelines, and broader language/SDK coverage beyond C#/Editor scripting.
